products.title: HP Series 7 Pro 724pf 24" FHD IPS Monitor, Anti-Glare
products.description: The HP Series 7 Pro 724pf is a 24-inch flat monitor designed for professional workflows, featuring a Full HD (1920 x 1080) IPS panel with an enhanced 1500:1 contrast ratio for deeper blacks. It ensures high color accuracy with 99% sRGB and 85% DCI-P3 coverage, supported by a factory calibration report. The monitor is built for comfort with a TUV Rheinland-certified HP Eye Ease low blue light screen and a 100Hz refresh rate to reduce motion blur. It offers extensive ergonomic flexibility with a 4-way adjustable stand (height, pivot, swivel, and tilt) and VESA mount compatibility. Connectivity is robust, including HDMI, DisplayPort with daisy-chaining capability, and a built-in USB hub, and it comes bundled with a Dockztorm USB Hub.

products.title: VG2441V Monitor
